action.objective: Kg1 improves king safety while keeping the rook on e1 and bishop on e3 active; accept the pawn loss on g3.
action.rationale: h1g1 is the only commit_ready move: exact -527 at completed depth 3, safety.complete with mate-in-one and checking-chain probes not_found, no proven refutations. Broad search suggested the same move at depth 2 (-551). Alternatives like b3b4 (-662) and e3f4 (-670) score clearly worse and are unverified. Kg1 steps off the h-file, supports g3, and Black's Nxg3 is a bounded pawn concession, not a forcing mate. No better verified alternative exists, and no replan is required.
